title: YouTube Guitar Tab Parser
claim: Show HN: YouTube Guitar Tab Parser
why_good: A CLI that downloads a YouTube guitar lesson, uses Claude vision to locate and crop the tab region in each frame, deduplicates by bar number, and stitches the distinct lines into a single PDF. It works out of the box with no configuration.
value: Amateur guitarists who follow YouTube lessons pay for a convenient way to get a printable PDF of the tab, saving time and frustration.
risk: YouTube could add a native tab download feature, or users might simply use existing tab websites, making this a niche tool with limited demand.

zh.claim: 吉他学习者观看带屏幕标签的YouTube课程时，不得不暂停和滚动来跟上，他们想要一个干净的PDF标签以便离线练习。
zh.hook: 吉他学习者观看带屏幕标签的YouTube课程时，不得不暂停和滚动来跟上，他们想要一个干净的PDF标签以便离线练习。
zh.does: 一个命令行工具，下载YouTube吉他课程，使用Claude视觉定位并裁剪每帧中的标签区域，按小节号去重，并将不同的行拼接成单个PDF。开箱即用，无需配置。
zh.why_use: 它自动化了繁琐的手动过程：暂停视频阅读标签、处理滚动和光标移动。它生成一个干净、可打印的PDF，比视频更容易跟随，并且处理角落覆盖或全宽标签的视频。
zh.gap: 它只是一个命令行工具，需要Node.js、yt-dlp、ffmpeg和Anthropic API密钥——只有极客才能使用。没有友好的产品，没有GUI，没有托管服务，也不支持其他视频平台或语言。
zh.counter: YouTube本身可能会添加“下载标签”功能，而像Ultimate Guitar这样的吉他标签网站已经提供官方标签。独立开发者要对抗免费的标签库和平台自身功能，难度很大。
zh.differentiator: 将其打包为简单的Web应用或浏览器扩展，用户粘贴YouTube URL即可获得PDF，无需安装任何东西或拥有API密钥。
zh.value: 跟随YouTube课程学习的业余吉他手会为方便地获得可打印的PDF标签付费，节省时间和挫败感。
zh.risk: YouTube可能会添加原生标签下载功能，或者用户可能直接使用现有的标签网站，使这个工具成为小众产品，需求有限。
zh.why_good: 一个命令行工具，下载YouTube吉他课程，使用Claude视觉定位并裁剪每帧中的标签区域，按小节号去重，并将不同的行拼接成单个PDF。开箱即用，无需配置。

does: A CLI that downloads a YouTube guitar lesson, uses Claude vision to locate and crop the tab region in each frame, deduplicates by bar number, and stitches the distinct lines into a single PDF. It works out of the box with no configuration.
why_use: It automates a tedious manual process: pausing videos to read tabs, dealing with scrolling and cursor movement. It produces a clean, printable PDF that is easier to follow than the video, and it handles videos with corner overlays or full-width tabs.
gap: CLI-only, no product around the capability for non-technical guitarists
counter: YouTube itself could add a 'download tab' feature, and guitar tab websites like Ultimate Guitar already offer official tabs. A solo builder faces an uphill battle against free tab repositories and the platform's own features.
differentiator: Package it as a simple web app or browser extension where a user pastes a YouTube URL and gets a PDF, without needing to install anything or have an API key.
hook: Guitar learners who watch YouTube lessons with on-screen tabs are stuck pausing and scrolling to follow along, and want a clean PDF of the tab to practice offline.
consumer_angle: A web app where a guitarist pastes a YouTube link and gets a clean PDF of the tab, no terminal needed
pick_reason: Demand not verified yet; capability signal for a consumer product.
